widgets_values:
**Describe your scene → Run.**

Start with the defaults. **Upscale 2x** is on; turn it off for a draft. Your seed advances automatically. Double-click **Video Generation** to inspect the stages.

4K output (3840 × 2176) -> Set Base Width: 1920, Base Height: 1088, and Upscale 2x: On.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: A female opera singer stands center stage in front of a full orchestra, delivering a soaring aria with expressive gestures and a poised, commanding presence. Their chest rises with a measured breath before they sustain a powerful, resonant note. Behind them, violin bows move in unison as the conductor guides the musicians. Warm golden stage lighting illuminates the singer and the polished instruments against the concert hall’s ornate backdrop. The camera slowly moves closer from a full-body shot to a medium close-up, capturing the emotion on the singer’s face. Rich operatic vocals blend with sweeping strings, mellow woodwinds, and swelling brass, reverberating naturally through the hall.
